json.medium: Flat vector graphic design with vintage stipple distressing
json.shading: Completely flat color blocking with zero shading, highlights, or dimension.
json.texture: Subtle, uniform stipple/speckle grunge overlay applied across the entire design, giving a printed or weathered vintage feel.
evidence: IMAGE 1, 2, 4: feature a mustard yellow background circle.
IMAGE 3, 5: feature a rust orange background circle.
IMAGE 6: exception - uses a dark green background circle instead of warm sun tones.
IMAGE 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6: use the exact same mountain and pine tree vector silhouettes.
IMAGE 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6: apply an identical stipple distress texture uniformly across all colors.

linework.style: Clean, crisp geometric vector edges with no hand-drawn wobble, relying purely on solid shapes.
linework.weight: Thick outer ring and thin inner ring for the badge frame; interior landscape elements have zero linework.

typography.vibe: Bold, tall, condensed vintage sans-serif with a rugged, industrial, or classic park-ranger aesthetic.
typography.placement: Arched along the upper inner curve of the badge frame with wide kerning/tracking. A second line of text is centered horizontally inside the bottom rectangular banner.

json.composition: Concentric circular badge format. A large, solid-colored circle anchors the center, partially covered by flat mountain silhouettes in the foreground. A cluster of stylized pine trees sits on the lower left of the mountains. A heavy solid rectangular horizontal banner overlaps the bottom quarter of the circle.
signature_moves: solid black mountain silhouette crossing a large colored circle
cluster of flat green pine trees positioned exclusively on the left side
widely tracked arched text filling the top negative space
